skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — convert this AVI to MP4 so I can upload it to YouTube — and get converted...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release summary: Launches "Data Format Converter Online" for fast, cloud-based video file conversion, especially to MP4.

- Quickly convert AVI, MOV, MKV, WebM, and other video formats up to 500MB to MP4 via cloud GPUs.
- No need for local software — just describe your requirements or upload your files.
- Automatic session setup and brief onboarding, with free anonymous access (100 credits for 7 days).
- Clear workflows for edit, export, state checking, and error handling. 
- Supports batch processing, iterative editing, and real-time status updates in chat.
